title: Impressions up 18%. Clicks up 6%.

title: CTR fell from 3.0% to 2.7%
body: One sample month from our SEO report guide.

title: Seen more often, picked less often
body: That can be fine or a problem. The 18% alone will not tell you which.

title: Accurate and still misleading
body: A summary that opens with 18% and buries CTR in a table further down.

title: Impressions and clicks go side by side
body: Never report one without the other.

title: Work out the CTR yourself
body: So the drop is not news to you when the client asks.

title: Lead with the number that draws questions
body: Under every metric, write what you will do about it.

title: Rewrite this month's opening line
body: Start with the line most likely to get a question, then the action.
